tools.name: assess_rwa_evidence
tools.description: Evaluate supplied RWA/tokenized-stock evidence against an explicit policy. Unsigned diagnostic only: caller-supplied facts are not authenticated, and ALLOW does not authorize a trade. Existing pre-trade and authorization checks remain required.

tools.name: get_robinhood_rwa_instrument
tools.description: Resolve a Robinhood Stock Token to Insight committed master data, using share-class FIGI for the underlying and ISO 10383 MIC for its primary market, then cross-check issuer UID, ISIN and contract deployment. Reference/admission evidence only; it never counts toward price quorum or authorizes a trad

tools.name: get_robinhood_rwa_context
tools.description: Get Robinhood Stock Token issuer context: official asset identity, trading capabilities, halt state, corporate actions, multiplier-normalized reference price, and optional on-chain ERC-8056 verification. First-party evidence only; it is not an independent oracle and never counts toward oracle quorum

tools.name: get_oracle_price
tools.description: Fetch the latest price from a specific oracle provider for an asset.

tools.name: get_consensus_price
tools.description: Get the aggregated consensus price for an asset across multiple oracle providers. Useful when you need a robust, manipulation-resistant reference price.

tools.name: get_risk_summary
tools.description: Get a composite risk summary for an asset across selected oracle providers. Includes HHI concentration, volatility, correlation, freshness, manipulation resistance, and shared-dependency risk.

tools.name: get_oracle_health
tools.description: Get the ecosystem-wide oracle health report for a specific date (uptime, staleness, and success rates across all providers). Use this for a dated snapshot of overall health. For a single feed by UUID use get_feed_health; to scan current freshness across many feeds use get_feed_freshness.

tools.name: check_liquidation_risk
tools.description: Check protocol liquidation risk for a specific date. Returns stress-test results based on representative benchmark positions.

tools.name: compare_oracle_deviation
tools.description: Compare historical price deviations across oracle providers for an asset. Helps identify which providers consistently diverge from consensus.

tools.name: get_stablecoin_peg
tools.description: Check stablecoin peg status. Provide a symbol for a specific stablecoin, or omit it to get all tracked stablecoins.

tools.name: get_protocol_risk_params
tools.description: Get risk parameters for a specific DeFi protocol, including liquidation thresholds, LTV ratios, and collateral factors.

tools.name: get_symbols
tools.description: List supported asset symbols. Optionally filter by a search query. Use this when you are unsure whether a symbol is supported.

tools.name: recommend_oracle_setup
tools.description: Recommend oracle provider setup for an asset based on active feeds. Use this to decide which providers to include in price feeds or risk analysis.

tools.name: get_stablecoin_list
tools.description: List all tracked stablecoin symbols.

tools.name: get_oracle_prices_batch
tools.description: Fetch prices for multiple assets/providers in a single request. Up to 20 queries.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get historical price data for an asset from a specific oracle provider over a period (in hours).

tools.name: get_cross_chain_spreads
tools.description: Get pairwise price spreads across chains for a given provider and symbol. Useful for cross-chain arbitrage and risk tracking.

tools.name: get_wrapped_asset_peg
tools.description: Check wrapped asset (e.g. WBTC, wstETH) peg status. Provide a symbol for a specific asset, or omit it to get all tracked wrapped assets.

tools.name: get_protocols
tools.description: Get a list of lending protocols with dynamic data (TVL, asset counts, oracle providers used). Optionally filter by name/slug query.

tools.name: get_protocol_oracle_exposure
tools.description: Analyze oracle provider concentration risk for a specific lending protocol. Shows which providers cover which assets and concentration metrics.

tools.name: get_feed_freshness
tools.description: Scan current freshness/staleness across many active feeds, filterable by provider, symbol, or category. Use this to find feeds needing attention right now. For a single feed by UUID use get_feed_health; for a dated ecosystem-wide report use get_oracle_health.

tools.name: get_feeds
tools.description: List oracle feeds from the registry with optional filters (provider, symbol, category, chain, active status). Useful for discovering available feeds and their metadata.

tools.name: get_feed_health
tools.description: Get detailed point-in-time health status for ONE specific oracle feed by its UUID (consecutive failures, last success/failure, status). For ecosystem-wide health by date use get_oracle_health; to scan freshness across many feeds use get_feed_freshness.

tools.name: get_feed_uptime
tools.description: Analyze feed data-delivery reliability over a date range: success rate, hours with data, coverage %, and average snapshots per day per provider+symbol. Use this to assess how completely a feed delivered data over time — distinct from get_feed_health (point-in-time status) and get_latency (speed).

tools.name: get_reputation_rankings
tools.description: Get oracle provider reputation rankings with trend over a period (1-90 days).

tools.name: get_provider_reputation
tools.description: Get detailed reputation metrics for a specific oracle provider, optionally with historical trend.

tools.name: get_daily_report
tools.description: Get the full daily oracle/risk report for a specific date, including liquidation risks, anomalies, and market summary.

tools.name: get_incidents
tools.description: Get oracle incidents and deviation events within a date range. Filter by provider and minimum severity.

tools.name: get_latency
tools.description: Analyze 15-minute oracle collector latency statistics (min, mean, p50, p90, p95, p99) over a date range, optionally filtered by provider or symbol.

tools.name: get_anomalies
tools.description: Get aggregated oracle anomaly events over a lookback period (1-30 days), including top deviation events and risk impacts.

tools.name: get_correlation
tools.description: Compute pairwise Pearson correlation of oracle provider deviations for an asset over a date range. Helps identify independent vs correlated providers.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Identify oracle coverage gaps and single-provider-risk symbols (assets served by only one oracle — a concentration risk). Returns breakdowns by provider, chain, and symbol. Use this when assessing where coverage is thin. For ecosystem scale plus top reputable providers, use get_metrics instead.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Compact ecosystem overview: provider/feed/symbol/chain/category counts plus top providers ranked by reputation score. Use this for a quick scale snapshot or provider ranking. To find coverage gaps and single-provider risk, use get_coverage instead.

tools.name: check_position_safety
tools.description: Check the safety of a DeFi lending position against oracle deviation stress tests. Supports multi-asset or single-asset positions.

tools.name: pre_trade_safety_check
tools.description: Pre-trade oracle safety checkpoint for AI agents. Call this BEFORE executing any on-chain swap/borrow/lend/liquidation/repay to assess oracle risk. Aggregates cross-oracle consensus prices, per-provider deviation, data freshness, stablecoin peg status, and reputation into a single verdict: PASS / CA

tools.name: oracle_watch
tools.description: Ongoing cross-oracle risk signal for an asset: current consensus deviation, agreement, quorum, outliers and staleness condensed into a NORMAL / CAUTION / DANGER verdict with a proceed / proceed_with_caution / halt recommendation. Agents should gate long-running strategies (yield, keeper, portfolio)

tools.name: oracle_watch_history
tools.description: Retrospective Oracle Watch trend for an asset: verdict stability, degraded-time ratio, worst deviation and mean credibility over the last N days, plus the recent series. Use it to judge whether a feed has been dependable, not just whether it is healthy this instant. History is guaranteed only for th

tools.name: execution_receipt
tools.description: Issue signed execution-price evidence comparing an observed fill with the oracle-assessed quote and signed slippage band. Provide the pre-trade fields (preTradeUid, requestHash, asset ids, chain, oracle gate counts) plus the settlement txHash. Insight collects the on-chain fill, signs a receipt pair

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_oracle_health, get_feed_freshness, get_feeds, get_feed_health, get_feed_uptime, get_metrics · Private data: get_robinhood_rwa_instrument, get_robinhood_rwa_context, agent_begin_trade · Public sink: get_robinhood_rwa_instrument · Destructive: pre_trade_safety_check, agent_begin_trade, verify_execution_pair.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_oracle_health, get_feed_freshness, get_feeds, get_feed_health, get_feed_uptime, get_metrics · Private data: get_robinhood_rwa_instrument, get_robinhood_rwa_context, agent_begin_trade · Public sink: get_robinhood_rwa_instrument · Destructive: pre_trade_safety_check, agent_begin_trade, verify_execution_pair

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
